faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: Does my client pay to follow the project?
faq.a1: No. Your client follows the project in the portal at no cost. If you want to share more, like downloading photos and seeing the full finances, Client Access is a one-time fee per project, paid by you on PRO.
faq.q2: Can I use it on my computer and my phone?
faq.a2: Yes. ObraFácil works on Android, iPhone, Windows and in the browser, with the same data everywhere.
faq.a3: Data travels encrypted and is stored on Google’s servers, also encrypted. Each person only sees the projects they take part in, with the permissions of their role.
faq.q4: What personal data do you collect?
faq.a4: For the account: name, email address and phone number; a tax number only if you provide it. The full list, and what each piece of data is for, is in the Privacy Policy.
faq.a5: Yes. Without internet, the app keeps what you record on the device and sends it automatically when the connection returns.
faq.q6: Does the client lose access to the files when the project ends?
faq.a6: If the project is 70% complete or more when access ends, the client still has 15 days to view and download what was shared.
faq.q7: Does ObraFácil replace the project engineer?
faq.a7: No. It is a management tool and does not replace the qualified professional responsible for the works.
faq.a8: Yes, under Profile > Delete account. The account is suspended for 30 days (you can change your mind) and then your projects and data are deleted. Some records, such as payments and acceptance of the Terms, are kept for the period set out in the Privacy Policy.
faq.q9: Can I cancel PRO or the storage expansion?
faq.a9: Yes, at any time, in the same place you subscribed. The next renewal is not charged and access continues until the end of the paid period.
faq.q10: What if a renewal is not paid?
faq.a10: The account goes back to the free plan. Nothing is deleted; if you are over the free plan limit, only uploading new files is blocked until you free up space or subscribe again.
faq.q11: Does the app have quality inspection checklists?
faq.a11: Yes. With Quality checklists you inspect each piece of work item by item, with photos, log any nonconformance with a corrective action and reinspection, and approve the work with a signature. On your phone it works even with no signal: what you record syncs when you're back online. On the free plan, you can start 3 checklists in total with the 27 ready-made templates, so you can try it out; on PRO, checklists are unlimited and you can create your company's own templates. The ready-made templates are examples to review and adapt: they don't replace the qualified professional responsible for the works, and they don't certify compliance with any code or quality program.

checklist.metaDescricao: {{nome}}: free quality checklist template with what to inspect before, during and at completion of the work. Download the PDF or use it in the ObraFácil app.
checklist.paraQue: This template tells you what to inspect on the work at three points: before starting, during the work and at completion. Each item is marked Pass, Fail or N/A. Anything that fails becomes a nonconformance, with a corrective action and reinspection, until the work is approved.

diario.metaDescricao: Free construction daily report template with weather, crew, work done, incidents, photos and sign-off. Download the PDF or fill it in on the ObraFácil app.
diario.paraQue: A daily report records the day on site: the weather, who worked, what got done, what happened and the photos, signed by the person responsible. This template has the same fields as the ObraFácil daily report.

campos.data: The report date and the project's client.

campos.avanco: How much of the project is complete, as a percentage.
campos.efetivo: Who worked that day: name, role, hours and attendance, as one of these options:
campos.avulsa: People who worked without being on the project team, with their role and hours.
campos.atividades: What got done that day, trade by trade.
campos.observacoes: Visits, deliveries, problems and anything that needs attention.
campos.fotos: The day's photos, numbered, with what each one shows.
campos.responsavel: Name and signature of the person responsible for the work.

usar.titulo: How to use it on paper
checklist: Download the PDF and print one sheet for each type of work and each location you inspect.
Fill in the project, location, stage, inspection date and who inspected.
On each item, check Pass, Fail or N/A, and note what you saw.
For anything that fails, write what was wrong, the corrective action, who it's assigned to and the due date. Then record the reinspection.
Once the work has been checked, mark the approval and sign.
diario: Download the PDF and print one sheet for each workday.
Fill in the date, client and progress, and check the day's weather.
List the crew on site with each person's role, hours and attendance, plus any extra labor.
Write down the work done and the incidents, and number the day's photos.
At the end of the day, the person responsible signs.
